subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan SKILL.md detection outside configured skill roots, and should it run in skills check/Doctor, status, or startup?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but scan scope, privacy, performance, false-positive policy, and remediation wording are product decisions rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Doctor/check diagnostic
options.body: Add an explicit Doctor or openclaw skills check warning for likely orphan skill directories while leaving normal startup/status paths bounded to configured roots.

options.title: Always-visible status warning
options.body: Surface orphan warnings in status/list/startup too, accepting more background scanning and a higher false-positive burden.

options.title: Document configured-root scope
options.body: Close the code request and rely on Skill Workshop plus docs to tell users where durable skills must live.

recommendation.title: Doctor/check diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Doctor or openclaw skills check warning for likely orphan skill directories while leaving normal startup/status paths bounded to configured roots.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history signal for skill-creator workflow ownership and the product boundary between Skill Workshop, skills status, and core diagnostics.
